# 1  Shared helpers

```{r helpers}
# Safe left_join: warns if RHS has duplicate keys
safe_left_join <- function(x, y, by) {
  dups <- y %>% count(across(all_of(by))) %>% filter(n > 1)
  if (nrow(dups) > 0)
    message("WARNING: duplicate RHS keys for join on: ", paste(by, collapse = ", "))
  left_join(x, y, by = by)
}

# Safe division (returns NA instead of Inf / NaN)
safe_div <- function(num, den) {
  ifelse(is.finite(num) & is.finite(den) & den != 0, num / den, NA_real_)
}

# Shared ggplot theme used throughout
theme_lcc <- function(...) {
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 2),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      ...
    )
}

# StudyArea display order
STUDY_AREA_LEVELS <- c("AK tundra", "AK boreal", "AK maritime",
                       "Yukon", "NWT", "Quebec", "NL", "Sweden")
```

# 2  Build atmosphere / bomb-curve reference

```{r atmosphere}
# Atmospheric bomb curve: Hua et al. (2021) NH Zone 1, as annual means placed
# at mid-year (used in 5.3). Soil increments integrate C over years, so the
# seasonal cycle in the monthly record is not meaningful here, and the annual
# series is monotonic on the falling limb.
bomb_annual <- as.data.frame(Hua2021$NHZone1) %>%
  filter(Year >= 1950) %>%
  group_by(yr = floor(Year)) %>%
  summarise(F14C = mean(mean.F14C), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(year = yr + 0.5) %>%
  arrange(year)

BOMB_PEAK_YR <- bomb_annual$year[which.max(bomb_annual$F14C)]   # rising limb = before this
curve_rising  <- bomb_annual %>% filter(year <= BOMB_PEAK_YR)
curve_falling <- bomb_annual %>% filter(year >= BOMB_PEAK_YR)
cat("Bomb peak (annual means):", BOMB_PEAK_YR, "F14C =", round(max(bomb_annual$F14C), 4), "\n")
cat("Falling limb monotonic:", all(diff(curve_falling$F14C) < 0), "\n")

```

# 4  Radiocarbon data

## 4.1  Load & clean long-format radiocarbon file

```{r rc-load}
radio <- read_csv("LCC_14C_long_clean_08262025.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    new.depth    = `new depth`,
    new.X14C     = `new X14C`,
    new.X14C.err = `new X14C.err`,
    new.F14C     = `new F14C`,
    new.F14C.err = `new F14C.err`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    depth      = coalesce(`new.depth`,    depth),
    X14C       = coalesce(`new.X14C`,     X14C),
    X14C.err   = coalesce(`new.X14C.err`, X14C.err),
    F14C       = coalesce(`new.F14C`,     F14C),
    F14C.err   = coalesce(`new.F14C.err`, F14C.err)
  ) %>%
  select(-starts_with("new.")) %>%
  mutate(
    Researcher = if_else(Researcher == "Pare", "Pare-Laganiere", Researcher),
    across(c(site, plot, siteplot), as.character)
  )

# Sample relabels: measured values moved to a different position in the core
# where they are out of depth order in a way consistent with a labelling
# mix-up. Affected profiles are
# flagged (samples_relabeled = TRUE in the archive) so they can be excluded
# or tested in sensitivity analysis. The original label stays in `section`.
SAMPLE_RELABELS <- tribble(
  ~ID,       ~new_section, ~new_depth, ~relabel_reason,
  # MID <-> BOTTOM
  "LCC_170", "BOTTOM",      9,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # Lab-03
  "LCC_171", "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  "LCC_280", "BOTTOM",     28,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # TUN10 23AP40B1
  "LCC_281", "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  "LC_222",  "BOTTOM",      3,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # LC_188C
  "LC_223",  "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  "RC138",   "BOTTOM",      3,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # ZF20-10A_12
  "RC139",   "MID",         2,  "MID/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",
  # TOP <-> BOTTOM (core reversed)
  "LCC_233", "BOTTOM",     20,  "TOP/BOTTOM swap (unverified)",   # Sample 5
  "LCC_235", "TOP",         1,  "TOP/BOTTOM swap (unverified)"
  # LCC-10-JB and Jl-02-1 are NOT swapped: their only inversion involves MID,
  # which is tolerated (6.4), and swapping would replace their measured old
  # surface carbon with a bomb-carbon sample.
)

stopifnot(all(SAMPLE_RELABELS$ID %in% radio$ID))

radio <- radio %>%
  left_join(SAMPLE_RELABELS, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Section_new = coalesce(new_section, Section_new),
    depth       = coalesce(new_depth, depth)
  ) %>%
  select(-new_section, -new_depth, -relabel_reason)

RELABELED_CORES <- radio %>% filter(ID %in% SAMPLE_RELABELS$ID) %>% distinct(soilID) %>% pull(soilID)
cat("Profiles with relabelled samples:", length(RELABELED_CORES), "\n")
```

## 4.2  Join site-level data to radiocarbon data

```{r rc-site-join}
# Site-level input: one row per soil profile (built by LCC_build_site_input.Rmd)
site_input <- read_csv("LCC_site_input.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Archive-only profiles: set in LCC_build_site_input.Rmd (column archive_only).
stopifnot("archive_only" %in% names(site_input),
          "Eco_override" %in% names(site_input))
ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS <- site_input$soilID[coalesce(as.logical(site_input$archive_only), FALSE)]
cat("Archive-only profiles:", length(ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS), "\n")
print(ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS)

SITE_CLEAN_COLS <- c(
  "project", "StudyArea", "Researcher", "fire", "site", "plot", "siteplot",
  "Year_of_Burn", "year", "stand_age", "stand_age_imputed", "stand_age14C",
  "Stand_age_SD", "Stand_age_number",
  "Latitude", "Longitude", "Elevation", "Slope", "Aspect",
  "Moisture_Class", "ForestType", "Eco_Type", "reburn_class_final",
  "Dom_Understory", "Dom_ground",
  "burn_depth", "residualSOL_depth", "residualSOL.C", "SOL.C.Combusted", "prefireSOL.C",
  "SOL_depth_SD", "SOL_depth_number",
  "Burn_depth_SD", "Burn_depth_number",
  "Thaw_depth", "Thaw_depth_SD", "Thaw_depth_number",
  "Burn_depth_method", "age_method", "area_sampled", "area_sampled_trees",
  "tree1_species", "tree1_density", "tree1_density_SD",
  "tree1_basalarea", "tree1_basalarea_SD",
  "tree2_species", "tree2_density", "tree2_density_SD",
  "tree2_basalarea", "tree2_basalarea_SD",
  "tree3_species", "tree3_density", "tree3_basalarea",
  "Coordinate_Reference_System..projection.or.EPSG."
)

# Rows in the same order as the original site join (non-NWT plot-level,
# non-NWT site-level researchers, then NWT), so order-dependent steps are unchanged
SKIP_PLOT <- c("Hung-Natali", "Baltzer", "Diaz-Veraverbeke")

radio_ord <- bind_rows(
  radio %>% filter(tolower(project) != "nwt", !Researcher %in% SKIP_PLOT),
  radio %>% filter(tolower(project) != "nwt",  Researcher %in% SKIP_PLOT),
  radio %>% filter(tolower(project) == "nwt")
)

# Burn year and stand-origin year for each sample (used in 5.3 and 5.6)
all_joined <- radio_ord %>%
  left_join(site_input %>% select(soilID, Year_of_Burn, year),
            by = "soilID", relationship = "many-to-one")

# NWT siteplot is left empty here, The real siteplot is
# restored in the archive (section 7).
sr1 <- radio_ord %>%
  mutate(siteplot = if_else(tolower(project) == "nwt", NA_character_, siteplot)) %>%
  select(ID, project, Researcher:siteplot, soilID:rerolled)
write_csv(sr1, "LCC_14C_long_clean_05162026.csv")
```

# 5  Radiocarbon age assignment

## 5.1  Classify pre-/post-bomb

```{r rc-bomb-classify}
rc_long <- read_csv("LCC_14C_long_clean_05162026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Classified on F14C, the measured quantity. Pre-1950 carbon never exceeds
# F14C ~0.99, so F14C > 1 means the sample contains bomb carbon. (D14C is not
# used here because labs computed it with different reference years.)
rc_classified <- rc_long %>%
  mutate(
    carbon_era = case_when(
      F14C > 1  ~ "Post-bomb",
      F14C <= 1 ~ "Pre-bomb",
      TRUE      ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

prebomb  <- filter(rc_classified, carbon_era == "Pre-bomb")
postbomb <- filter(rc_classified, carbon_era == "Post-bomb")


```

## 5.2  Pre-bomb: Bchron calibration

```{r rc-prebomb}
prebomb <- prebomb %>%
  mutate(
    F14C.err_abs = X14C.err / 1000,
    C14age       = -8033 * log(F14C),
    C14age_sd    = 8033 * F14C.err_abs / F14C
  )
cal_pre <- BchronCalibrate(
  ages      = prebomb$C14age,
  ageSds    = prebomb$C14age_sd,
  calCurves = rep("intcal20", nrow(prebomb)),
  ids       = prebomb$ID,
  allowOutside = TRUE
)

prebomb$calibrated_median <- sapply(
  cal_pre,
  function(x) median(x$ageGrid[x$densities == max(x$densities)])
)
prebomb$calendar_year_median <- 1950 - prebomb$calibrated_median

# Sanity check: age SDs should be ~9-40 yr (not ~900-4000)
summary(prebomb$C14age_sd)

# 95% highest-density regions: number of separate solutions and overall range
# (hdr() returns intervals in years BP; converted to calendar years here)
cal_hdr <- purrr::map(cal_pre, ~ Bchron::hdr(.x, prob = 0.95))

prebomb <- prebomb %>%
  mutate(
    cal_n_modes = purrr::map_int(cal_hdr, length),
    cal_lo95    = 1950 - purrr::map_dbl(cal_hdr, ~ max(unlist(.x))),
    cal_hi95    = 1950 - purrr::map_dbl(cal_hdr, ~ min(unlist(.x)))
  )

prebomb %>% count(cal_n_modes)

prebomb %>%
  filter(cal_n_modes > 1) %>%
  select(soilID, Section_new, depth, X14C, calendar_year_median, cal_lo95, cal_hi95) %>%
  arrange(soilID, depth)

# Candidate solutions per sample: each 95% interval holding >= 10% of the
# probability, represented by its most probable year. Used by the
# stratigraphic-order rule in 5.6.
cand_pre <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  list(cal = cal_pre, ints = cal_hdr, id = prebomb$ID),
  function(cal, ints, id) {
    tot <- sum(cal$densities)
    purrr::map_dfr(ints, function(iv) {
      inside <- cal$ageGrid >= min(iv) & cal$ageGrid <= max(iv)
      tibble(
        ID        = id,
        cand_year = 1950 - cal$ageGrid[inside][which.max(cal$densities[inside])],
        mass      = sum(cal$densities[inside]) / tot
      )
    })
  }
) %>%
  filter(mass >= 0.10)

cand_pre %>% count(ID, name = "n_major") %>% count(n_major)
```

## 5.3  Post-bomb: read calendar years off the bomb curve

```{r rc-postbomb}
# Post-bomb samples (F14C > 1) are dated by reading their F14C off the
# atmospheric bomb curve (Hua et al. 2021, NH Zone 1). The curve is reduced to
# annual means placed at mid-year: soil increments integrate C over years, so
# the seasonal cycle in the monthly record is not meaningful here, and the
# annual series is monotonic on the falling limb.
#
# Every post-bomb F14C value (below the peak) crosses the curve twice: once
# on the rising limb (1955-1964) and once on the falling limb (1964 on).
# Both years are calculated here; which one a sample gets is decided by the
# depth rules in 5.6. 
#
# Special cases (flagged in curve_flag):
#  - rising limb 1959-1961: the curve dips, so a value can cross it up to three
#    times; the midpoint of the first and last crossing is used
#    ("rising_plateau").
#  - F14C above the annual peak: assigned the peak year ("above_peak").
#  - F14C below the last falling-limb value (curve ends 2019): the falling limb
#    is extended using the linear trend of its last 10 years ("extrapolated").
#
# Residual soil carbon cannot post-date the fire: a solution later than
# Year_of_Burn + FIRE_CAP_TOL is marked as not allowed (except archive-only
# profiles, sampled decades after fire). 5.6 uses the other limb if only that
# one is allowed. This uses the most recent fire, not stand origin, so it is
# not circular with the legacy C definition.

FIRE_CAP_TOL    <- 2                       # yr
NO_FIRE_CAP     <- ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS    # soilIDs
EXTRAP_TREND_YR <- 10                      # yr of the falling limb used to extend it

tail_fit <- lm(F14C ~ year, data = tail(curve_falling, EXTRAP_TREND_YR))

# Year(s) where a limb crosses F14C value x (linear interpolation between annual means)
read_limb <- function(x, crv, limb) {
  yv <- crv$F14C; xv <- crv$year; n <- length(yv)
  if (is.na(x)) return(c(NA_real_, NA))
  if (x >= max(yv)) return(c(BOMB_PEAK_YR, "above_peak"))
  i <- which((yv[-n] - x) * (yv[-1] - x) <= 0 & yv[-n] != yv[-1])
  if (length(i) == 0) {
    if (limb == "falling" && x < min(yv)) {
      yr <- (x - coef(tail_fit)[1]) / coef(tail_fit)[2]
      return(c(unname(yr), "extrapolated"))
    }
    return(c(NA_real_, "no_crossing"))
  }
  yrs <- xv[i] + (x - yv[i]) / (yv[i + 1] - yv[i]) * (xv[i + 1] - xv[i])
  if (length(i) > 1) return(c(mean(range(yrs)), paste0(limb, "_plateau")))
  c(yrs, "ok")
}

fire_cap <- all_joined %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(ID, burn_year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Year_of_Burn)))

postbomb_1 <- postbomb %>%
  left_join(fire_cap, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(cap = if_else(soilID %in% NO_FIRE_CAP | is.na(burn_year),
                       NA_real_, burn_year + FIRE_CAP_TOL))

rise <- purrr::map(postbomb_1$F14C, read_limb, crv = curve_rising,  limb = "rising")
fall <- purrr::map(postbomb_1$F14C, read_limb, crv = curve_falling, limb = "falling")

postbomb_1 <- postbomb_1 %>%
  mutate(
    year_rising   = as.numeric(purrr::map_chr(rise, 1)),
    flag_rising   = purrr::map_chr(rise, 2),
    year_falling  = as.numeric(purrr::map_chr(fall, 1)),
    flag_falling  = purrr::map_chr(fall, 2),
    rising_ok     = !is.na(year_rising)  & (is.na(cap) | year_rising  <= cap),
    falling_ok    = !is.na(year_falling) & (is.na(cap) | year_falling <= cap),
    # Provisional age (replaced by the depth rules in 5.6): falling limb if allowed
    calendar_year_median = case_when(falling_ok ~ year_falling,
                                     rising_ok  ~ year_rising,
                                     TRUE       ~ NA_real_)
  )

# Both solutions per sample (used for the stand-origin flag, rule 2)
cand_post <- bind_rows(
  postbomb_1 %>% filter(rising_ok)  %>% transmute(ID, cand_year = year_rising,  mass = 1),
  postbomb_1 %>% filter(falling_ok) %>% transmute(ID, cand_year = year_falling, mass = 1)
)

postbomb_1 %>% count(flag_rising, flag_falling)
postbomb_1 %>% count(rising_ok, falling_ok)
```


## 5.4  Combine pre- and post-bomb ages

```{r rc-combine}
rc_age <- bind_rows(prebomb, postbomb_1) %>%
  mutate(F14C.err_abs = X14C.err / 1000) %>%   # absolute Fm error, same units for all samples
  select(project, Researcher, StudyArea, fire, site, plot, siteplot,
         soilID, ID, Section_new, depth,
         X14C, X14C.err, F14C, F14C.err_abs, notes, calendar_year_median)
```


## 5.5  Core-level structural corrections

```{r rc-structural-fixes}
# Mineral basal samples: in these profiles the BOTTOM sample was mineral soil
# (confirmed in the lab), so it does not date the organic layer. The BOTTOM sample
# is dropped and MID becomes the basal (deepest organic) date.
MINERAL_BOTTOM <- c("LCC-11-JB", "LCC-12-JB", "Sweden B", "WF-LCC-1")
RELABEL_MID_TO_BOTTOM <- MINERAL_BOTTOM   # name used in later diagnostic chunks

rc_age <- rc_age %>%
  filter(!(soilID %in% MINERAL_BOTTOM & Section_new == "BOTTOM")) %>%
  mutate(Section_new = if_else(soilID %in% MINERAL_BOTTOM & Section_new == "MID",
                               "BOTTOM", Section_new))

cat("Profiles with a mineral basal sample (MID used as basal date):",
    length(MINERAL_BOTTOM), "\n")
```

## 5.6  Age rules: limb rule, stratigraphic order, and stand-origin flag

```{r rc-order-rules}
# Pre-bomb samples keep their Bchron mode (5.2). Post-bomb samples get the
# rising- or falling-limb year from 5.3, chosen by these rules:
#
# Rule 1a - limb rule, applied down each profile (TOP -> BOTTOM; deeper = older).
#  * The first post-bomb sample is compared with the sample directly below it,
#    if that sample is within ADJ_CM. It is assumed to lie on the same side of
#    the bomb peak as that sample:
#      - higher F14C than the sample below -> rising limb
#      - lower F14C than the sample below  -> falling limb
#      - sample below is pre-bomb          -> rising limb (closest in time to
#        pre-1950 carbon; see rule 1d for weak bomb signals)
#  * Each deeper post-bomb sample then follows from the one above it:
#      - above is on the rising limb  -> rising (older on the rising limb)
#      - above is on the falling limb and this sample has higher F14C -> falling
#      - above is on the falling limb and this sample has lower F14C  -> rising
#        (the profile has crossed the bomb peak)
#  * Pairs whose F14C differs by less than 2 sigma follow the same rule and are
#    flagged (within_error). Equal values are treated as falling.
#  * V-shaped profiles (TOP, MID and BOTTOM all post-bomb; MID lower than both):
#    MID is treated as the odd sample (MID inversions are tolerated, 6.4) and
#    all three take the limb given by TOP vs BOTTOM (flagged "V_top_vs_bottom").
#  * A post-bomb sample with no sample within ADJ_CM below it to compare with
#    gets the falling limb (flagged "no_sample_below" / "no_close_sample_below").
#  * If the chosen limb's year post-dates the fire (5.3) and the other limb's
#    does not, the other limb is used (flagged "fire_cap_switch").
#


ORDER_TOL_YR <- 0   # yr
ADJ_CM       <- 4   # cm; max gap to the sample below used to set a limb (rules 1a, 1d)

cand_all <- bind_rows(cand_pre, cand_post)   # all possible ages (rule 2)

rc_age <- rc_age %>%
  mutate(
    core       = soilID,
    sec_rank   = match(Section_new, c("TOP","MID","BOTTOM")),
    age_source = case_when(
      ID %in% prebomb$ID    ~ "prebomb_mode",
      ID %in% postbomb_1$ID ~ "postbomb_curve",
      TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ---- Rule 1a: walk down each profile -------------------------------------
walk_limbs <- function(F, err, post, depth) {
  n <- length(F)
  limb <- rep(NA_character_, n); basis <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  within <- rep(NA, n)
  close_below <- function(k) k < n && (depth[k + 1] - depth[k]) <= ADJ_CM
  # V-shaped profile: TOP, MID, BOTTOM all post-bomb and MID lower than both
  if (n == 3 && all(post) && F[2] < F[1] && F[2] < F[3] && close_below(1)) {
    l <- if (F[1] > F[3]) "rising" else "falling"
    return(tibble(limb = rep(l, 3), limb_basis = "V_top_vs_bottom",
                  within_error = abs(F[1] - F[3]) <= 2 * sqrt(err[1]^2 + err[3]^2)))
  }
  for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    if (!post[k]) next
    if (k > 1 && post[k - 1] && !is.na(limb[k - 1])) {
      within[k] <- abs(F[k] - F[k - 1]) <= 2 * sqrt(err[k]^2 + err[k - 1]^2)
      if (limb[k - 1] == "rising") {
        limb[k]  <- "rising"
        basis[k] <- if (F[k] > F[k - 1]) "below_rising_but_higher" else "below_rising"
      } else if (F[k] >= F[k - 1]) {
        limb[k] <- "falling"; basis[k] <- "below_falling"
      } else {
        limb[k] <- "rising";  basis[k] <- "crossed_peak"
      }
    } else if (close_below(k)) {
      if (!post[k + 1]) {
        limb[k] <- "rising"; basis[k] <- "above_prebomb"
      } else {
        within[k] <- abs(F[k] - F[k + 1]) <= 2 * sqrt(err[k]^2 + err[k + 1]^2)
        if (F[k] > F[k + 1])      { limb[k] <- "rising";  basis[k] <- "higher_than_below" }
        else if (F[k] < F[k + 1]) { limb[k] <- "falling"; basis[k] <- "lower_than_below" }
        else                      { limb[k] <- "falling"; basis[k] <- "tie" }
      }
    } else {
      limb[k]  <- "falling"
      basis[k] <- if (k < n) "no_close_sample_below" else "no_sample_below"
    }
  }
  tibble(limb = limb, limb_basis = basis, within_error = within)
}

limb_walk <- rc_age %>%
  filter(!is.na(calendar_year_median)) %>%
  arrange(core, sec_rank, depth) %>%
  group_by(core) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, key) {
    bind_cols(d %>% select(ID),
              walk_limbs(d$F14C, d$F14C.err_abs, d$age_source == "postbomb_curve", d$depth))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(limb)) %>%
  left_join(postbomb_1 %>% select(ID, year_rising, year_falling, rising_ok, falling_ok,
                                  flag_rising, flag_falling),
            by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(
    fire_cap_switch = (limb == "falling" & !falling_ok & rising_ok) |
                      (limb == "rising"  & !rising_ok  & falling_ok),
    limb       = if_else(fire_cap_switch, if_else(limb == "falling", "rising", "falling"), limb),
    limb_basis = if_else(fire_cap_switch, paste0(limb_basis, "; fire_cap_switch"), limb_basis),
    limb_year  = if_else(limb == "rising", year_rising, year_falling),
    curve_flag = if_else(limb == "rising", flag_rising, flag_falling),
    limb_year  = if_else(if_else(limb == "rising", rising_ok, falling_ok), limb_year, NA_real_)
  )

cat("Post-bomb samples by limb and basis:\n")
limb_walk %>% count(limb, limb_basis) %>% print(n = Inf)
cat("Curve special cases:\n")
limb_walk %>% count(curve_flag) %>% print()
cat("Within-error comparisons:", sum(limb_walk$within_error, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Post-bomb samples with no allowed year on either limb:", sum(is.na(limb_walk$limb_year)), "\n")

rc_age <- rc_age %>%
  left_join(limb_walk %>% select(ID, limb, limb_basis, within_error, curve_flag, limb_year),
            by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(calendar_year_median = if_else(age_source == "postbomb_curve" & !is.na(limb_year),
                                        limb_year, calendar_year_median)) %>%
  select(-limb_year)

# TOP vs the sample below it (used by rule 1d and for reporting)
limb_rule <- rc_age %>%
  filter(!is.na(X14C), !is.na(calendar_year_median)) %>%
  group_by(core) %>%
  summarise(
    partner      = if (any(Section_new == "MID")) "MID" else "BOTTOM",
    top_post     = any(Section_new == "TOP" & age_source == "postbomb_curve"),
    partner_pre  = any(Section_new == partner & age_source == "prebomb_mode"),
    partner_post = any(Section_new == partner & age_source == "postbomb_curve"),
    depth_gap    = mean(depth[Section_new == partner]) - mean(depth[Section_new == "TOP"]),
    limb         = first(limb[Section_new == "TOP"]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(top_post, partner_pre | partner_post) %>%
  mutate(pair_type = if_else(partner_post, "both_post", "partner_pre"))

# ---- Rule 1b: stratigraphic order ----------------------------------------
order_ok <- function(yrs) {
  n <- length(yrs)
  if (n < 2) return(TRUE)
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) for (j in (i + 1):n)
    if (yrs[j] - yrs[i] > ORDER_TOL_YR) return(FALSE)
  TRUE
}

violating_cores <- rc_age %>%
  filter(!is.na(calendar_year_median)) %>%
  arrange(core, sec_rank) %>%
  group_by(core) %>%
  summarise(violates = !order_ok(calendar_year_median), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(violates) %>%
  pull(core)

best_ordered <- function(years_list, mass_list) {
  idx <- expand.grid(lapply(years_list, seq_along))
  yrs <- matrix(sapply(seq_along(years_list), function(j) years_list[[j]][idx[[j]]]),
                nrow = nrow(idx))
  ms  <- matrix(sapply(seq_along(mass_list),  function(j) mass_list[[j]][idx[[j]]]),
                nrow = nrow(idx))
  ok  <- apply(yrs, 1, order_ok)
  if (!any(ok)) return(NULL)
  score <- apply(ms, 1, prod)
  best  <- which(ok)[which.max(score[ok])]
  list(years = yrs[best, ], share = score[best] / sum(score[ok]))
}

# Candidates: pre-bomb samples use their major Bchron solutions; post-bomb
# samples have one fixed year (rule 1a)
cands <- rc_age %>%
  filter(core %in% violating_cores, !is.na(calendar_year_median)) %>%
  select(ID, core, sec_rank, age_source, calendar_year_median) %>%
  left_join(cand_pre, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(
    use_cands = age_source == "prebomb_mode" & !is.na(cand_year),
    cand_year = if_else(use_cands, cand_year, calendar_year_median),
    mass      = if_else(use_cands, mass, 1)
  ) %>%
  distinct(ID, core, sec_rank, cand_year, mass)

order_fixes <- cands %>%
  arrange(core, sec_rank) %>%
  group_by(core) %>%
  group_modify(function(d, key) {
    s   <- split(d, factor(d$ID, levels = unique(d$ID)))
    res <- best_ordered(lapply(s, `[[`, "cand_year"), lapply(s, `[[`, "mass"))
    if (is.null(res)) {
      return(tibble(ID = names(s), new_year = NA_real_,
                    order_share = NA_real_, resolved = FALSE))
    }
    tibble(ID = names(s), new_year = unname(res$years),
           order_share = res$share, resolved = TRUE)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

unresolved_cores <- order_fixes %>% filter(!resolved) %>% distinct(core) %>% pull(core)

rc_age <- rc_age %>%
  left_join(order_fixes %>% select(ID, new_year, order_share), by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(
    order_flag = case_when(
      core %in% unresolved_cores ~ "inversion_unresolved",
      core %in% violating_cores  ~ "order_fixed",
      TRUE                       ~ "ok"
    ),
    changed              = !is.na(new_year) & new_year != calendar_year_median,
    old_year             = calendar_year_median,
    age_source           = if_else(changed, sub("_mode$", "_rule_fix", age_source), age_source),
    calendar_year_median = if_else(changed, new_year, calendar_year_median)
  )

cat("Cores out of depth order after rule 1a:", length(violating_cores),
    "| fixed by alternative pre-bomb solutions:", length(setdiff(violating_cores, unresolved_cores)),
    "| unresolved:", length(unresolved_cores), "\n")
rc_age %>%
  filter(core %in% violating_cores) %>%
  arrange(order_flag, core, sec_rank) %>%
  select(order_flag, core, Section_new, depth, F14C, age_source, limb,
         old_year, calendar_year_median, order_share) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

rc_age <- rc_age %>% select(-new_year, -changed, -old_year)

# Rule 1c - rising-limb spread. In profiles where every sample contains bomb
# carbon and the rules above put them all on the rising limb, D14C usually
# declines with depth (bomb carbon mixed downward), and matching each sample
# to the curve compresses the whole profile into 1-3 years. For these profiles
# (TOP-BOTTOM span < MIN_YR_PER_CM), ages are spread over the rising limb by
# depth: TOP = 1964 (bomb peak); each deeper sample is SURFACE_RATE years per
# cm older, but not older than 1955 (first year atmospheric D14C > 0).
# SURFACE_RATE is the median years per cm between TOP and MID in profiles
# where both are unambiguously on the falling limb.
MIN_YR_PER_CM  <- 1
SPREAD_TOP_YR  <- 1964
SPREAD_BASE_YR <- 1955

SURFACE_RATE <- rc_age %>%
  filter(Section_new %in% c("TOP","MID"), !is.na(calendar_year_median),
         !soilID %in% ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS) %>%
  group_by(core) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, all(calendar_year_median > BOMB_PEAK_YR)) %>%
  summarise(
    r = (first(calendar_year_median[Section_new == "TOP"]) - first(calendar_year_median[Section_new == "MID"])) /
        (first(depth[Section_new == "MID"]) - first(depth[Section_new == "TOP"])),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(r), r >= 0) %>%
  pull(r) %>%
  median()
cat("Surface accumulation (median yr per cm, falling-limb TOP/MID pairs):", round(SURFACE_RATE, 2), "\n")

spread_cores <- rc_age %>%
  filter(!is.na(calendar_year_median), order_flag != "inversion_unresolved") %>%
  group_by(core) %>%
  filter(any(Section_new == "TOP"), any(Section_new == "BOTTOM")) %>%
  summarise(
    all_post   = all(grepl("^postbomb", age_source)),
    all_rising = all(calendar_year_median < BOMB_PEAK_YR),
    yr_per_cm  = (calendar_year_median[Section_new == "TOP"][1] -
                  calendar_year_median[Section_new == "BOTTOM"][1]) /
                 (depth[Section_new == "BOTTOM"][1] - depth[Section_new == "TOP"][1]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(all_post, all_rising, yr_per_cm < MIN_YR_PER_CM) %>%
  pull(core)

rc_age <- rc_age %>%
  group_by(core) %>%
  mutate(
    top_depth   = suppressWarnings(min(depth[!is.na(calendar_year_median)])),
    spread_year = pmax(SPREAD_BASE_YR, SPREAD_TOP_YR - (depth - top_depth) * SURFACE_RATE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    in_spread            = core %in% spread_cores & !is.na(calendar_year_median),
    age_source           = if_else(in_spread, "rising_spread", age_source),
    calendar_year_median = if_else(in_spread, spread_year, calendar_year_median)
  ) %>%
  select(-top_depth, -spread_year, -in_spread)

cat("Profiles given rising-limb spread ages:", length(spread_cores), "\n")
rc_age %>%
  filter(core %in% spread_cores) %>%
  arrange(core, sec_rank) %>%
  select(core, Section_new, depth, X14C, calendar_year_median) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Rule 1d - TOP takes the age of the sample below it. If TOP is post-bomb with
# D14C <= TOP_FROM_MID_MAX_D14C and the sample directly below it (MID, or
# BOTTOM if no MID; within ADJ_CM) is pre-bomb, TOP's small bomb signal is
# attributed to post-fire input (post-fire atmospheric D14C was ~0 to +20
# per mil for fires in 2013-2022) mixed into old residual carbon, and TOP is
# assigned the age of the sample below. This age is an upper bound for the
# residual surface. Applies instead of the rising-limb date from rule 1a.
TOP_FROM_MID_MAX_D14C <- 20

tfm <- limb_rule %>%
  filter(pair_type == "partner_pre", depth_gap <= ADJ_CM) %>%
  select(core, partner) %>%
  inner_join(rc_age %>% filter(Section_new == "TOP") %>%
               distinct(core, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% select(core, top_x = X14C),
             by = "core") %>%
  filter(top_x <= TOP_FROM_MID_MAX_D14C) %>%
  inner_join(rc_age %>% select(core, Section_new, partner_year = calendar_year_median),
             by = c("core", "partner" = "Section_new")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(partner_year))

top_from_mid_cores <- tfm$core

rc_age <- rc_age %>%
  left_join(tfm %>% select(core, partner_year), by = "core") %>%
  mutate(
    is_tfm               = Section_new == "TOP" & !is.na(partner_year),
    age_source           = if_else(is_tfm, "top_from_mid", age_source),
    calendar_year_median = if_else(is_tfm, partner_year, calendar_year_median)
  ) %>%
  select(-partner_year, -is_tfm)

cat("Profiles where TOP takes the age of the sample below:", length(top_from_mid_cores), "\n")
tfm %>% arrange(top_x) %>% print(n = Inf)

# Rule 2: flag samples whose major solutions straddle stand origin
origin <- all_joined %>%
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(ID, origin_year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year)))

straddle_ids <- cand_all %>%
  inner_join(origin, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(origin_year)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(straddles = any(cand_year < origin_year) & any(cand_year > origin_year),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(straddles) %>%
  pull(ID)

rc_age <- rc_age %>%
  mutate(straddles_origin = ID %in% straddle_ids)

rc_age %>% count(age_source)
rc_age %>% filter(straddles_origin) %>% count(Section_new)


```

### Checks that the rules worked

```{r rc-age-checks}
# 1. No residual surface (TOP) may post-date its fire (archive-only exempt)
top_after_fire <- rc_age %>%
  left_join(fire_cap, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(Section_new == "TOP", !soilID %in% NO_FIRE_CAP,
         calendar_year_median > burn_year + FIRE_CAP_TOL)
cat("TOP samples dated after their fire:", nrow(top_after_fire), "\n")
stopifnot(nrow(top_after_fire) == 0)

# 2. Every post-bomb sample received a limb and an allowed year
cat("Post-bomb samples without a year:", sum(is.na(limb_walk$limb_year)), "\n")

write_csv(rc_age %>% select(-core, -sec_rank), "LCC_soil_age_clean_05162026.csv")
```

# 6  C pools and legacy C partitioning

## 6.1  Load data and join

```{r cn-load}
site_input <- read_csv("LCC_site_input.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Site table at the fire/site/plot level, as used by the joins below
site <- site_input %>%
  select(any_of(c(SITE_CLEAN_COLS, "ForestGroup", "Dom_species", "Moisture_3", "AgeClass",
                  "Eco_override"))) %>%
  distinct(project, StudyArea, Researcher, fire, site, plot, siteplot, .keep_all = TRUE)

rc_age <- read_csv("LCC_soil_age_clean_05162026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cn     <- read.csv("LCC_Soil_CN_clean.csv") %>%
  mutate(siteplot = if_else(field_id == "DragMooTrip25C", "25_C", siteplot))

KEYS <- c("project","StudyArea","Researcher","fire","site","plot","siteplot")

LC2 <- rc_age %>%
  left_join(site, by = KEYS, relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  distinct()

LC2_wide <- LC2 %>%
  dplyr::select(project, Researcher, StudyArea, fire, site, plot, siteplot,
                soilID, Section_new, X14C, calendar_year_median, depth) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = Section_new,
              values_from = c(X14C, calendar_year_median, depth),
              names_sep   = "_",
              values_fn   = mean)

LC3 <- LC2_wide %>%
  left_join(site, by = KEYS, relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  mutate(
    year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(year)),
    calendar_year_median_BOTTOM = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(calendar_year_median_BOTTOM)),
    calendar_year_median_TOP    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(calendar_year_median_TOP)),
    LC.present   = if_else(!is.na(calendar_year_median_BOTTOM) &
                             year < calendar_year_median_BOTTOM, "Absent", "Present"),
    LC.combusted = if_else(!is.na(calendar_year_median_TOP) &
                             year > calendar_year_median_TOP, "Lost", "Accumulate"),
    legacyCpresent.num   = as.integer(LC.present   == "Present"),
    legacyCcombusted.num = as.integer(LC.combusted == "Lost")
  )
```

```{r pl-bd-impute}
# Depth-specific mean bd.fine for Pare-Laganiere
pl_bd_means <- cn %>%
  filter(Researcher == "Pare-Laganiere", !is.na(bd.fine)) %>%
  group_by(soil_depth_top_cm) %>%
  summarise(bd_imputed = mean(bd.fine, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pl_bd_overall <- cn %>%
  filter(Researcher == "Pare-Laganiere", !is.na(bd.fine)) %>%
  summarise(bd_imputed = mean(bd.fine, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(bd_imputed)

cn <- cn %>%
  left_join(
    pl_bd_means %>% mutate(Researcher = "Pare-Laganiere"),
    by = c("Researcher", "soil_depth_top_cm")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bd.fine = case_when(
      Researcher == "Pare-Laganiere" & is.na(bd.fine) & !is.na(bd_imputed) ~ bd_imputed,
      Researcher == "Pare-Laganiere" & is.na(bd.fine)                      ~ pl_bd_overall,
      TRUE ~ bd.fine
    ),
    sample.depth = case_when(
      Researcher == "Pare-Laganiere" & is.na(sample.depth) ~
        as.numeric(soil_depth_bottom_cm - soil_depth_top_cm),
      TRUE ~ sample.depth
    ),
    gC.m2 = if_else(
      Researcher == "Pare-Laganiere" & is.na(gC.m2) & !is.na(bd.fine) & !is.na(C_weight_per),
      C_weight_per / 100 * bd.fine * sample.depth * 10000,
      gC.m2
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-bd_imputed)

names(cn)
```

## 6.2  CN data processing

```{r cn-process}
# Four profiles exempt from C% trimming
CN_TRIM_EXEMPT <- c("134_C", "360_C", "111_C", "30_A")

cn_filtered <- cn %>%
  filter(Researcher == "Walker/Mack" | siteplot %in% CN_TRIM_EXEMPT) %>%
  bind_rows(
    cn %>%
      filter(Researcher != "Walker/Mack", !siteplot %in% CN_TRIM_EXEMPT) %>%
      group_by(siteplot) %>%
      arrange(soil_depth_top_cm, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(
        n_samples  = n(),
        threshold  = if_else(n_samples == 1, 15, 20),
        last_good  = suppressWarnings(
                       max(row_number()[C_weight_per >= threshold], na.rm = TRUE)),
        keep       = is.finite(last_good) & row_number() <= last_good
      ) %>%
      filter(keep) %>%
      select(-last_good, -keep, -n_samples, -threshold) %>%
      ungroup()
  )

# Walker/Mack: join on fire+site only
site_by_fs <- site %>%
  group_by(fire, site) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-plot, -siteplot)

cnsite_wm <- filter(cn_filtered, Researcher == "Walker/Mack") %>%
  left_join(site_by_fs, by = c("fire","site"), suffix = c("", ".site")) %>%
  mutate(
    project   = coalesce(project,   project.site),
    StudyArea = coalesce(StudyArea, StudyArea.site)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".site"))

cnsite_other <- filter(cn_filtered, Researcher != "Walker/Mack") %>%
  left_join(site, by = c("project","StudyArea","Researcher","fire","site","plot","siteplot"))

cnsite <- bind_rows(cnsite_wm, cnsite_other) %>%
  group_by(project, Researcher, StudyArea, field_id, fire, site, plot, siteplot) %>%
  arrange(coalesce(soil_depth_top_cm, soil_depth_bottom_cm, 0), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_from_samples = cumsum(replace_na(sample.depth, 0)),
    total.depth      = if_else(is.na(sample.depth),
                               coalesce(soil_depth_bottom_cm, cum_from_samples),
                               cum_from_samples),
    prefire.sol      = residualSOL_depth + burn_depth
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Correct Hung-Natali residual depth
cnsite <- cnsite %>%
  mutate(residualSOL_depth = if_else(Researcher == "Hung-Natali",
                                     total.depth, residualSOL_depth))

# Profiles where ALL samples were removed by C% filter — entire SOL below threshold
# These get Cpool.tot = 0 from sum(), not NA, so need explicit identification
all_filtered_siteplots <- cn %>%
  filter(Researcher != "Walker/Mack", !siteplot %in% CN_TRIM_EXEMPT) %>%
  group_by(siteplot) %>%
  summarise(
    n_with_C  = sum(!is.na(C_weight_per)),
    n_total    = n(),
    threshold  = if_else(n() == 1, 15, 20),
    n_above    = sum(C_weight_per >= if_else(n() == 1, 15, 20), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_above == 0, n_with_C > 0) %>%   # n_with_C > 0 prevents catching Walker sites
  pull(siteplot)

cat("Profiles with all samples below C% threshold:", length(all_filtered_siteplots), "\n")
print(all_filtered_siteplots)

# Summarise totals per profile
CN.tot <- cnsite %>%
  group_by(project, Researcher, StudyArea, field_id, fire, site, plot, siteplot) %>%
  summarise(
    Cpool.tot   = sum(gC.m2,   na.rm = TRUE),
    Npool.tot   = sum(gN.m2,   na.rm = TRUE),
    total.depth = if (all(is.na(sample.depth))) max(soil_depth_bottom_cm, na.rm = TRUE)
                  else sum(sample.depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Top and bottom sample densities
cn_top_bottom <- cnsite %>%
  group_by(project, Researcher, StudyArea, fire, site, plot, siteplot) %>%
  summarise(
    top_C_weight_per    = first(C_weight_per),
    bottom_C_weight_per = last(C_weight_per),
    top_sample_depth    = first(sample.depth),
    bottom_sample_depth = last(sample.depth),
    top_bd_fine         = first(bd.fine),
    bottom_bd_fine      = last(bd.fine),
    top_gC_m2           = first(gC.m2),
    bottom_gC_m2        = last(gC.m2),
    mean_bd             = mean(bd.fine,      na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_C_pct          = mean(C_weight_per, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_N_pct          = mean(N_weight_per, na.rm = TRUE),
    profile_depth       = sum(sample.depth,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(project, Researcher, StudyArea, fire, site, plot, siteplot) %>%
  summarise(across(top_C_weight_per:profile_depth, ~ first(na.omit(.))),
            .groups = "drop")
```

## 6.3  Join CN data; bring in Walker/Mack SOL pools

```{r cn-join}
CN.all <- LC3 %>%
  left_join(cn_top_bottom, by = KEYS) %>%
  left_join(CN.tot %>% filter(Researcher != "Walker/Mack"), by = KEYS) %>%
  left_join(
    CN.tot %>%
      filter(Researcher == "Walker/Mack") %>%
      group_by(project, StudyArea, fire, site) %>%
      summarise(across(c(Cpool.tot, Npool.tot, total.depth),
                       ~ suppressWarnings(max(., na.rm=TRUE))),
                .groups="drop") %>%
      rename(Cpool_wm=Cpool.tot, Npool_wm=Npool.tot, depth_wm=total.depth),
    by = c("project","StudyArea","fire","site")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cpool.tot      = coalesce(Cpool.tot,   Cpool_wm),
    Npool.tot      = coalesce(Npool.tot,   Npool_wm),
    total.depth.cn = coalesce(total.depth, depth_wm)
  ) %>%
  select(-Cpool_wm, -Npool_wm, -depth_wm, -total.depth)

# Walker/Mack measured SOL pools
mw_sol <- site_input %>%
  select(soilID,
         SOL.C.Combusted_new = SOL.C.Combusted_WM,
         prefireSOL.C_new    = prefireSOL.C_WM,
         residualSOL.C_new   = residualSOL.C_WM)

CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  left_join(mw_sol, by = "soilID") %>%
  mutate(
    SOL.C.Combusted = coalesce(SOL.C.Combusted_new, SOL.C.Combusted),
    prefireSOL.C    = coalesce(prefireSOL.C_new,    prefireSOL.C),
    residualSOL.C   = coalesce(residualSOL.C_new,   residualSOL.C),
    Cpool.tot       = if_else(is.na(Cpool.tot), residualSOL.C, Cpool.tot)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_new"))

# New SOL combustion estimates (Diaz-Veraverbeke, Gundale, Metcalfe)
new_comb <- site_input %>%
  dplyr::select(soilID, SOL.C.Combusted_new2 = SOL.C.Combusted_profile)

CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  left_join(new_comb, by = "soilID") %>%
  mutate(SOL.C.Combusted = coalesce(SOL.C.Combusted, SOL.C.Combusted_new2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-SOL.C.Combusted_new2)


```

```{r cn-depth-check}
# ── Trim Cpool.tot to RC bottom depth (whole sample approach) ─────────────────
# For profiles where total.depth.cn > depth_BOTTOM, the C/N profile extends
# deeper than the deepest radiocarbon sample. Recompute Cpool.tot per soilID
# by keeping only samples whose top depth is above depth_BOTTOM.
# cnsite is still in memory so we can join raw samples back to each soilID.
# Affects 10 sites (mainly Hung-Natali YKD tundra).

depth_by_soilID <- CN.all %>%
  select(soilID, siteplot, project, Researcher, StudyArea,
         fire, site, plot, depth_BOTTOM, total.depth.cn) %>%
  mutate(
    # Only trim if CN profile extends >5cm below RC bottom depth.
    # Within ±5cm is measurement tolerance — leave those untouched.
    depth_BOTTOM_trim = if_else(
      !is.na(depth_BOTTOM) & !is.na(total.depth.cn) &
        (total.depth.cn - depth_BOTTOM) > 5,
      depth_BOTTOM,
      NA_real_   # NA = no trim needed
    )
  )

Cpool_trimmed <- depth_by_soilID %>%
  left_join(
    cnsite %>% select(project, Researcher, StudyArea, fire, site, plot, siteplot,
                      soil_depth_top_cm, gC.m2, gN.m2),
    by = c("project","Researcher","StudyArea","fire","site","plot","siteplot")
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(depth_BOTTOM_trim) | soil_depth_top_cm < depth_BOTTOM_trim) %>%
  group_by(soilID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cn          = sum(!is.na(gC.m2)),
    Cpool_trimmed = sum(gC.m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Npool_trimmed = sum(gN.m2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Profiles with no CN samples keep their existing pool (e.g. Walker/Mack
  # measured residual SOL C) instead of being set to 0 by an empty sum
  mutate(
    Cpool_trimmed = if_else(n_cn > 0, Cpool_trimmed, NA_real_),
    Npool_trimmed = if_else(n_cn > 0, Npool_trimmed, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(-n_cn)

CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  left_join(Cpool_trimmed, by = "soilID") %>%
  mutate(
    Cpool.tot = if_else(!is.na(Cpool_trimmed), Cpool_trimmed, Cpool.tot),
    Npool.tot = if_else(!is.na(Npool_trimmed), Npool_trimmed, Npool.tot)
  ) %>%
  select(-Cpool_trimmed, -Npool_trimmed)

# ── QC: depth alignment check ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
depth_check <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(mismatch = depth_BOTTOM - total.depth.cn) %>%
  filter(!is.na(depth_BOTTOM), !is.na(total.depth.cn)) %>%
  select(siteplot, soilID, Researcher, StudyArea,
         depth_BOTTOM, total.depth.cn, mismatch) %>%
  arrange(desc(mismatch))

cat("Profiles with RC BOTTOM > lab total depth by >5cm:\n")
depth_check %>% filter(mismatch > 5) %>% as.data.frame() %>% print()

cat("\nProfiles where Cpool.tot was trimmed (CN deeper than RC bottom by >2cm):\n")
depth_check %>% filter(mismatch < -2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print()

ggplot(depth_check, aes(x = total.depth.cn, y = depth_BOTTOM, colour = StudyArea)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,  linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 5,  linetype = "dotted", colour = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Lab total depth (cm)", y = "RC BOTTOM sample depth (cm)",
       title = "RC bottom depth vs lab-derived SOL depth",
       subtitle = "Red dotted lines = ±5 cm tolerance") +
  theme_lcc()

CN.all %>%
  filter(soilID %in% c("YKD B-2", "YKD B-3", "YKD B-6", "YKD B-9")) %>%
  select(soilID, depth_BOTTOM, total.depth.cn, Cpool.tot)

CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    total.depth.cn_trimmed = if_else(
      !is.na(depth_BOTTOM) & (total.depth.cn - depth_BOTTOM) > 5,
      depth_BOTTOM,
      total.depth.cn
    )
  )

```

## 6.4  Filter age inversions

```{r cn-filter-inversions}
# A profile is excluded as inverted only if BOTTOM is younger than TOP: those
# two dates define the profile's age span and legacy C. Inversions involving
# MID are tolerated, because MID enters only through abs(TOP - MID) in 6.5.
CN.all.orig <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    age_inversion = coalesce(calendar_year_median_TOP < calendar_year_median_BOTTOM, FALSE),
    mid_inversion = coalesce(calendar_year_median_TOP < calendar_year_median_MID, FALSE) |
                    coalesce(calendar_year_median_MID < calendar_year_median_BOTTOM, FALSE),
    # Inverted profiles whose dates ALL fall on one side of stand origin (year):
    # the residual SOL is entirely legacy C (all dates older than stand origin)
    # or entirely new C (all dates younger), whatever the order of the dates,
    # so these are kept. Because the dates are out of order, the youngest dated
    # sample is treated as the residual surface and the oldest as the base:
    # residual years = youngest - oldest date, combusted years = fire year -
    # youngest date, prefire years = fire year - oldest date (as for ordered
    # profiles, where these are TOP and BOTTOM). Accumulation rates are set to
    # NA because the age-depth order is unknown.
    date_max = pmax(calendar_year_median_TOP, calendar_year_median_MID,
                    calendar_year_median_BOTTOM, na.rm = TRUE),
    date_min = pmin(calendar_year_median_TOP, calendar_year_median_MID,
                    calendar_year_median_BOTTOM, na.rm = TRUE),
    inversion_retained = age_inversion &
      coalesce(date_max < year | date_min > year, FALSE),
    inversion_all_legacy = inversion_retained & coalesce(date_max < year, FALSE)
  )

CN.all.orig <- CN.all.orig %>%
  mutate(samples_relabeled = soilID %in% RELABELED_CORES,
         rising_spread     = soilID %in% spread_cores,
         top_from_mid      = soilID %in% top_from_mid_cores)

cat("Profiles with a MID inversion (kept):", sum(CN.all.orig$mid_inversion & !CN.all.orig$age_inversion), "\n")

removed <- CN.all.orig %>%
  filter(age_inversion) %>%
  select(siteplot, StudyArea, Researcher,
         calendar_year_median_TOP, calendar_year_median_BOTTOM,
         stand_age, ForestType) %>%
  arrange(StudyArea, siteplot) %>%
  mutate(inversion_magnitude = calendar_year_median_BOTTOM - calendar_year_median_TOP)

cat("Profiles with age inversion:", nrow(removed), "\n")
as.data.frame(removed %>% arrange(inversion_magnitude))

# No dates are swapped between samples; all inverted profiles are excluded
# via exclusion_reason in section 6.5.1.
CN.all <- CN.all.orig

cat("Profiles with age inversion:", sum(CN.all$age_inversion, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  retained (all dates on one side of stand origin):", sum(CN.all$inversion_retained, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  excluded:", sum(CN.all$age_inversion & !CN.all$inversion_retained, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
CN.all %>% filter(inversion_retained) %>%
  select(soilID, year, inversion_all_legacy, calendar_year_median_TOP,
         calendar_year_median_MID, calendar_year_median_BOTTOM)
```


## 6.5  C accumulation rates and combustion estimates

```{r cn-rates-estimates}
# Impute burn_depth = 0 to 1 cm minimum
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(burn_depth = ifelse(burn_depth == 0, 1, burn_depth))

CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    # ── Years ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Retained inversions (6.4): youngest date = residual surface, oldest = base
    total_years             = if_else(inversion_retained,
                                      date_max - date_min,
                                      abs(calendar_year_median_TOP - calendar_year_median_BOTTOM)),
    age_span_years_burned   = if_else(inversion_retained,
                                      Year_of_Burn - date_max,
                                      abs(Year_of_Burn - calendar_year_median_TOP)),
    age_span_years_top      = if_else(inversion_retained, NA_real_,
                                      pmax(abs(calendar_year_median_TOP - calendar_year_median_MID), 1)),

    # ── Age–depth gradients ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    years_per_cm_profile = if_else(inversion_retained, NA_real_,
                                   safe_div(total_years, total.depth.cn_trimmed)),
    years_per_cm_used    = coalesce(age_span_years_top, years_per_cm_profile),
    years_removed_by_burn = pmin(burn_depth * years_per_cm_used, age_span_years_burned),

    # ── Accumulation rates (g C m⁻² yr⁻¹) ───────────────────────────────────
    C_accumulation_rate_residual   = if_else(inversion_retained, NA_real_,
                                             safe_div(Cpool.tot, total_years)),
    C_density_mean_per_cm          = safe_div(Cpool.tot,    total.depth.cn_trimmed),
    C_density_top_per_cm           = safe_div(top_gC_m2,   top_sample_depth),
    C_pool_top_1                   = C_density_top_per_cm * 1,
    C_accumulation_rate_top        = safe_div(C_pool_top_1, age_span_years_top),
    C_accumulation_rate_years_final = pmin(C_accumulation_rate_top,
                                           C_accumulation_rate_residual, na.rm = TRUE),

    # ── SOL C combustion estimates (kept for diagnostics/supplementary) ───────
    SOL.C.Combusted_profile_depth = C_density_mean_per_cm * burn_depth,
    SOL.C.Combusted_top_depth     = C_density_top_per_cm  * burn_depth,
    SOL.C.Combusted_profile_years = C_accumulation_rate_residual * age_span_years_burned,
    SOL.C.Combusted_top_years     = C_accumulation_rate_top      * age_span_years_burned,

    # ── Prefire SOL depth ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    prefire.sol = total.depth.cn_trimmed + burn_depth
  )

```

```{r cn-rates-model}
# Calibration model for sites missing measured SOL.C.Combusted
cal_dat <- CN.all %>%
  filter(!soilID %in% ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS,
         !is.na(burn_depth), !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted),
         !is.na(Moisture_Class), burn_depth > 0, SOL.C.Combusted > 0) %>%
  mutate(Moisture_3 = factor(Moisture_3, levels = c("dry", "moist", "wet"))) %>%   # from site file
  filter(!is.na(Moisture_3))

cat("Calibration model n:", nrow(cal_dat), "\n")

m_comb_cal <- glmmTMB(
  SOL.C.Combusted ~ burn_depth + I(burn_depth^2) + Moisture_3 + (1|StudyArea),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data   = cal_dat
)
summary(m_comb_cal)

# Moisture_3 for prediction (from the site file)
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(Moisture_3 = factor(Moisture_3, levels = c("dry", "moist", "wet")))

# Predict into all sites
CN.all$SOL.C.Combusted_modelled <- NA_real_
has_predictors <- !is.na(CN.all$burn_depth) & !is.na(CN.all$Moisture_3)
CN.all$SOL.C.Combusted_modelled[has_predictors] <- predict(
  m_comb_cal, newdata = CN.all[has_predictors, ],
  type = "response", allow.new.levels = TRUE
)

# Final combustion estimate and source tracking
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    SOL.C.Combusted_final = coalesce(SOL.C.Combusted,
                                     SOL.C.Combusted_modelled,
                                     SOL.C.Combusted_top_depth,
                                     SOL.C.Combusted_profile_depth,
                                     SOL.C.Combusted_profile_years),
    SOL.C.Combusted_source = case_when(
      !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted)               ~ "field measured",
      !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted_modelled)      ~ "modelled",
      !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted_top_depth)     ~ "top depth",
      !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted_profile_depth) ~ "profile depth",
      !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted_profile_years) ~ "profile years",
      TRUE                                  ~ "missing"
    )
  )

cat("SOL.C.Combusted source breakdown:\n")
print(CN.all %>% count(SOL.C.Combusted_source))

# Impute burn_depth for sites missing it but with SOL.C.Combusted_final
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    burn_depth_imputed = is.na(burn_depth) &
                         !is.na(SOL.C.Combusted_final) &
                         !is.na(C_density_mean_per_cm),
    burn_depth = case_when(
      !is.na(burn_depth) ~ burn_depth,
      burn_depth_imputed ~ SOL.C.Combusted_final / C_density_mean_per_cm,
      TRUE               ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

cat("Sites with imputed burn_depth:", sum(CN.all$burn_depth_imputed, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Sites still missing burn_depth:", sum(is.na(CN.all$burn_depth)), "\n")

```

## 6.5.1  Exclusion flags (no filtering — all profiles retained for archive)

```{r cn-exclusion-flags}
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    exclusion_reason = case_when(
      # Archived but not used in the manuscript (archive_only in site file)
      soilID %in% ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS                             ~ "not_in_manuscript",
      # Insufficient C is checked first: these profiles are not organic SOL,
      # so their dates are not used regardless of order
      siteplot %in% all_filtered_siteplots                         ~ "insufficient_C_concentration",
      # Age inversion (see 6.4)
      age_inversion & !inversion_retained                          ~ "age_inversion",
      # Missing residual C pool
      is.na(Cpool.tot)                                             ~ "missing_residual_C",
      # Missing surface radiocarbon date
      is.na(calendar_year_median_TOP)                              ~ "missing_RC_surface",
      # Missing basal radiocarbon date (neither BOTTOM nor MID)
      is.na(calendar_year_median_BOTTOM) &
        is.na(calendar_year_median_MID)                            ~ "missing_RC_basal",
      # Included
      TRUE                                                         ~ NA_character_
    ),
    included_in_analysis = is.na(exclusion_reason)
  )


MAX_MEASURED_BD <- max(CN.all$burn_depth[!CN.all$burn_depth_imputed &
                                          !CN.all$soilID %in% ARCHIVE_ONLY_SOILIDS],
                       na.rm = TRUE)

CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    exclusion_reason = if_else(
      is.na(exclusion_reason) & burn_depth_imputed & burn_depth > MAX_MEASURED_BD,
      "combustion_outlier", exclusion_reason),
    included_in_analysis = is.na(exclusion_reason)
  )


cat("Total profiles in archive:", nrow(CN.all), "\n")
cat("Included in analysis:     ", sum(CN.all$included_in_analysis), "\n\n")
cat("Exclusion reasons:\n")
print(CN.all %>% count(exclusion_reason, sort = TRUE))
```

## 6.6  Legacy C partitioning

```{r legacy-partition}
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    # Years of legacy C in residual SOL
    # Retained inversions: residual years are all legacy or all new
    legacy_years = if_else(inversion_retained,
                           if_else(inversion_all_legacy, total_years, 0), pmax(
      pmin(year, calendar_year_median_TOP) - calendar_year_median_BOTTOM,
      0, na.rm = TRUE
    )),
    # If TOP and BOTTOM have the same age (total_years = 0, e.g. rule 1d in a
    # two-sample core), the dated residual SOL is a single age: all legacy if
    # that age predates stand origin, none if it does not.
    legacy_frac = case_when(
      inversion_retained ~ as.numeric(inversion_all_legacy),   # 1 = all older than stand origin, 0 = all younger
      total_years %in% 0 & !is.na(calendar_year_median_BOTTOM) & !is.na(year) ~
        as.numeric(calendar_year_median_BOTTOM < year),
      TRUE ~ safe_div(legacy_years, total_years)
    ),
    legacy_C    = if_else(is.finite(legacy_frac), Cpool.tot * legacy_frac,       NA_real_),
    new_C       = if_else(is.finite(legacy_frac), Cpool.tot * (1 - legacy_frac), NA_real_),

    # Legacy combustion
    combustion_years         = age_span_years_burned,
    new_years_combusted      = pmin(combustion_years, stand_age),
    legacy_combustion_years  = pmin(pmax(combustion_years - stand_age, 0), combustion_years),

    prop.leg = case_when(
      is.na(combustion_years) | combustion_years == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ safe_div(legacy_combustion_years, combustion_years)
    ),

    legacy_combustion_C_final = prop.leg * SOL.C.Combusted_final,
    new_C_combusted           = SOL.C.Combusted_final - legacy_combustion_C_final
  )
```

# 6.10  prefire_depth, BS_Position, and Eco (8-level)

```{r eco-classification}
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    # ── Prefire SOL depth ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    prefire_depth = coalesce(depth_BOTTOM, total.depth.cn_trimmed, residualSOL_depth) + burn_depth,

    # ── Upland / Lowland position for black spruce ───────────────────────────
    # Threshold: prefire SOL >= 20 cm = Lowland; < 20 cm = Upland
    BS_Position = case_when(
      # AK boreal Other conifer treated as black spruce for this classification
      StudyArea == "AK boreal" & ForestGroup == "Other conifer" & prefire_depth >= 20 ~ "Lowland",
      StudyArea == "AK boreal" & ForestGroup == "Other conifer" & prefire_depth  < 20 ~ "Upland",
      StudyArea == "AK boreal" & ForestGroup == "Other conifer" & is.na(prefire_depth)~ "Upland",
      # Standard BS rules
      ForestGroup == "Black spruce" & prefire_depth >= 20 ~ "Lowland",
      ForestGroup == "Black spruce" & prefire_depth  < 20 ~ "Upland",
      # Fallback rules for missing prefire_depth
      StudyArea == "Yukon"     & ForestGroup == "Black spruce" & is.na(prefire_depth) ~ "Upland",
      StudyArea == "NWT"       & ForestGroup == "Black spruce" & is.na(prefire_depth) ~ "Lowland",
      StudyArea == "AK boreal" & ForestGroup == "Black spruce" & is.na(prefire_depth) ~ "Upland",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # ── Full 8-level ecosystem classification ─────────────────────────────────
    # Factor level order is drainage-first (dry → wet)
    Eco = case_when(
      # Profile-specific overrides from the site file (LCC_build_site_input.Rmd)
      !is.na(Eco_override) ~ as.character(Eco_override),
      # Siteplot-specific overrides
      siteplot == "36_1" ~ "Western NA Mixed/Deciduous",
      siteplot == "21_C" ~ "Western NA Upland Spruce",
      # Tundra
      ForestGroup == "Tundra / Non-forested"                                          ~ "Western NA Tundra",
      # Sweden
      StudyArea == "Sweden"                                                            ~ "Scandinavian Pine",
      # Deciduous/Mixed
      ForestGroup == "Deciduous/Mixed"                                                 ~ "Western NA Mixed/Deciduous",
      # Maritime black spruce (AK maritime and NL)
      StudyArea %in% c("AK maritime", "NL") & ForestGroup == "Black spruce"           ~ "Maritime NA Spruce",
      # Western black spruce — Upland
      StudyArea %in% c("AK boreal", "Yukon", "NWT") &
        ForestGroup %in% c("Black spruce", "Other conifer") &
        BS_Position == "Upland"                                                        ~ "Western NA Upland Spruce",
      # Western black spruce — Lowland
      StudyArea %in% c("AK boreal", "Yukon", "NWT") &
        ForestGroup %in% c("Black spruce", "Other conifer") &
        BS_Position == "Lowland"                                                       ~ "Western NA Lowland Spruce",
      # Eastern black spruce — Upland
      StudyArea == "Quebec" & ForestGroup == "Black spruce" & BS_Position == "Upland" ~ "Eastern NA Upland Spruce",
      # Eastern black spruce — Lowland
      StudyArea == "Quebec" & ForestGroup == "Black spruce" & BS_Position == "Lowland"~ "Eastern NA Lowland Spruce",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Eco = factor(Eco, levels = c(
      "Scandinavian Pine",
      "Western NA Mixed/Deciduous",
      "Maritime NA Spruce",
      "Western NA Upland Spruce",
      "Eastern NA Upland Spruce",
      "Western NA Lowland Spruce",
      "Eastern NA Lowland Spruce",
      "Western NA Tundra"
    ))
  )

cat("Eco counts:\n")
print(table(CN.all$Eco, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("Unclassified (check ForestGroup / BS_Position):\n")
CN.all %>% filter(is.na(Eco)) %>%
  count(Researcher, StudyArea, ForestGroup, BS_Position) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print()
```

# 6.12  Final C pool variables (prefire / residual / combusted)

```{r final-cpools}
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    # ── Prefire = residual + combusted ────────────────────────────────────────
    prefire_legacy_C  = legacy_C + legacy_combustion_C_final,
    prefire_new_C     = new_C + (SOL.C.Combusted_final - legacy_combustion_C_final),
    prefire_total_C   = prefire_legacy_C + prefire_new_C,
    prefire_legacy_yr = legacy_years + legacy_combustion_years,
    prefire_new_yr    = (total_years - legacy_years) +
                        (combustion_years - legacy_combustion_years),
    prefire_total_yr  = prefire_legacy_yr + prefire_new_yr,

    # ── Residual ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    resid_legacy_C  = legacy_C,
    resid_new_C     = new_C,
    resid_total_C   = resid_legacy_C + resid_new_C,    # == Cpool.tot
    resid_legacy_yr = legacy_years,
    resid_new_yr    = total_years - legacy_years,
    resid_total_yr  = total_years,

    # ── Combusted ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    comb_legacy_C  = legacy_combustion_C_final,
    comb_new_C     = SOL.C.Combusted_final - legacy_combustion_C_final,
    comb_total_C   = SOL.C.Combusted_final,
    comb_legacy_yr = legacy_combustion_years,
    comb_new_yr    = combustion_years - legacy_combustion_years,
    comb_total_yr  = combustion_years,

    # ── Proportions (clamped to avoid 0/1 boundary issues in beta models) ────
    prop_pre_leg_C   = pmin(pmax(safe_div(prefire_legacy_C,  prefire_total_C),  1e-6), 1-1e-6),
    prop_comb_leg_C  = pmin(pmax(safe_div(comb_legacy_C,     comb_total_C),     1e-6), 1-1e-6),
    prop_resid_leg_C = pmin(pmax(safe_div(resid_legacy_C,    resid_total_C),    1e-6), 1-1e-6),

    # ── Legacy C flags ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    LC_prefire   = prefire_legacy_C > 0,
    LC_resid     = resid_legacy_C   > 0,
    LC_combusted = comb_legacy_yr    > 0,
    LC_resid_bin = as.integer(LC_resid),
    LC_comb_bin  = as.integer(LC_combusted)
  )
```

# 6.13  Factor levels and BurnDepth_Class

```{r factor-vars}
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    # Canonical 6-level ordered factor (submesic replaces mesic-subxeric)
    # Moisture_Class, Moisture_3 and AgeClass come from the site file
    Moisture_Class = factor(Moisture_Class,
                            levels = c("xeric","subxeric","submesic",
                                       "mesic","mesic-subhygric","subhygric"),
                            ordered = TRUE),
    Moisture_3 = factor(Moisture_3, levels = c("dry","moist","wet")),
    AgeClass   = factor(AgeClass, levels = c("Short (<30 yr)","Mid (30-70 yr)","Long (>70 yr)")),

    BurnDepth_Class = case_when(
      burn_depth < 5              ~ "Shallow (<5 cm)",
      between(burn_depth, 5, 10)  ~ "Moderate (5-10 cm)",
      burn_depth > 10             ~ "Deep (>10 cm)",
      TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
    ),
    BurnDepth_Class = factor(BurnDepth_Class,
                             levels = c("Shallow (<5 cm)","Moderate (5-10 cm)","Deep (>10 cm)"))
  )
```

# 7  Write archive file

```{r write-archive}
CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  mutate(
    Longitude = if_else(
      StudyArea != "Sweden" & !is.na(Longitude) & Longitude > 0,
      -Longitude,
      Longitude
    )
  )


# ── Final QC before writing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Final sample size:", nrow(CN.all), "\n\n")
cat("StudyArea:\n"); print(table(CN.all$StudyArea, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nEco:\n");     print(table(CN.all$Eco,        useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nForestGroup:\n"); print(table(CN.all$ForestGroup, useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nLC flags (resid / combusted):\n")
print(table(LC_resid = CN.all$LC_resid, LC_combusted = CN.all$LC_combusted, useNA = "ifany"))

# ── Select archive columns ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Intermediate combustion variants (SOL.C.Combusted_profile_*, _modelled, etc.)
# and old flag names (LC.present, legacyCpresent.num) are intentionally excluded.

archive_cols <- c(
  # --- Identification ---
  "Researcher", "StudyArea",
  "fire", "site", "plot", "project", "siteplot", "field_id", "soilID",
  # --- Site characteristics ---
  "Year_of_Burn", "stand_age", "stand_age_imputed", "age_method",
  "Latitude", "Longitude", "Coordinate_Reference_System..projection.or.EPSG.",
  "Slope", "Aspect", "Elevation",
  "MAT", "MAP", "tree_cover",
  # --- Vegetation ---
  "ForestType", "Eco_Type", "ForestGroup", "Eco", "BS_Position", "Dom_species",
  # --- Fire / SOL structure ---
  "burn_depth", "BurnDepth_Class", "Burn_depth_method", "residualSOL_depth", "prefire_depth",
  "total.depth.cn", "total.depth.cn_trimmed", "Thaw_depth", "reburn_class_final",
  # --- SOL properties ---
  "mean_bd", "mean_C_pct", "mean_N_pct", "profile_depth",
  "Moisture_Class", "Moisture_3", "AgeClass",
  # --- SOL combustion (final values only) ---
  "SOL.C.Combusted_final", "SOL.C.Combusted_source",
  # --- Radiocarbon ages ---
  "calendar_year_median_TOP", "calendar_year_median_MID", "calendar_year_median_BOTTOM",
  "F14C_TOP", "F14C_MID", "F14C_BOTTOM",
  "X14C_TOP", "X14C_MID", "X14C_BOTTOM",
  "depth_TOP", "depth_MID", "depth_BOTTOM",
  # --- C pools — core ---
  "Cpool.tot", "Npool.tot", "prefireSOL.C",
  # --- Legacy C — prefire ---
  "prefire_legacy_C", "prefire_new_C", "prefire_total_C",
  "prefire_legacy_yr", "prefire_new_yr", "prefire_total_yr",
  # --- Legacy C — residual ---
  "resid_legacy_C", "resid_new_C", "resid_total_C",
  "resid_legacy_yr", "resid_new_yr", "resid_total_yr",
  # --- Legacy C — combusted ---
  "comb_legacy_C", "comb_new_C", "comb_total_C",
  "comb_legacy_yr", "comb_new_yr", "comb_total_yr",
  # --- Exclusion flags ---
  "exclusion_reason", "included_in_analysis",
  # --- Quality flags ---
  "age_inversion", "inversion_retained", "inversion_all_legacy", "mid_inversion", "samples_relabeled", "rising_spread", "top_from_mid", "burn_depth_imputed",
  # --- Flags and proportions ---
  "LC_prefire", "LC_resid", "LC_combusted",
  "LC_resid_bin", "LC_comb_bin",
  "prop.leg", "prop_pre_leg_C", "prop_comb_leg_C", "prop_resid_leg_C",
  # --- Accumulation rate diagnostics ---
  "C_accumulation_rate_residual", "C_density_mean_per_cm",
  "C_accumulation_rate_top", "C_density_top_per_cm",
  "years_per_cm_profile", "total_years"
)

# Columns left out of the published archive (and its dictionary).
# Duplicates and intermediates: not needed to reproduce any reported value.
ARCHIVE_DROP_REDUNDANT <- c(
  "Cpool.tot",                     # identical to resid_total_C
  "total_years",                   # identical to resid_total_yr
  "prop.leg",                      # = comb_legacy_yr / comb_total_yr (unclamped)
  "prop_pre_leg_C", "prop_comb_leg_C", "prop_resid_leg_C",   # clamped copies for beta models (not used)
  "C_accumulation_rate_top", "C_density_top_per_cm",         # intermediate combustion variants
  "years_per_cm_profile",
  "total.depth.cn",                # untrimmed lab depth; total.depth.cn_trimmed is the one used
  "Coordinate_Reference_System..projection.or.EPSG."         # empty for all profiles
)
# Site descriptors not used in any calculation or figure (sparse for some studies).
# Empty this vector to keep them.
ARCHIVE_DROP_UNUSED <- c("reburn_class_final")
archive_cols <- setdiff(archive_cols, c(ARCHIVE_DROP_REDUNDANT, ARCHIVE_DROP_UNUSED))

# F14C by sample position (the measured quantity used for dating), joined by soilID
f14c_wide <- rc_age %>%
  filter(Section_new %in% c("TOP", "MID", "BOTTOM"), !is.na(X14C)) %>%   # same samples as X14C (e.g. Sweden 41 MID/BOTTOM set to NA in 5.5)
  group_by(soilID, Section_new) %>%
  summarise(F14C = mean(F14C, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Section_new, values_from = F14C, names_prefix = "F14C_")

CN.all <- CN.all %>%
  select(-any_of(c("F14C_TOP", "F14C_MID", "F14C_BOTTOM"))) %>%
  left_join(f14c_wide, by = "soilID")

CN_archive <- CN.all %>%
  select(any_of(archive_cols)) %>%
  # restore NWT siteplot (left empty for the CN joins; see 4.2)
  left_join(radio %>% distinct(soilID, siteplot_rc = siteplot), by = "soilID") %>%
  mutate(siteplot = coalesce(siteplot, siteplot_rc)) %>%
  select(-siteplot_rc)

# Check for expected columns that are missing (likely a pipeline name change)
missing_cols <- setdiff(archive_cols, names(CN_archive))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0)
  stop("Expected archive columns not found (did every section in 6 run?): ",
       paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))

write_csv(CN_archive, "LCC_LegacyCarbon_archive_new8.csv")
cat("Final archive:", nrow(CN_archive), "rows,", ncol(CN_archive), "columns\n")
cat("  Included in analysis:  ", sum(CN_archive$included_in_analysis, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Excluded (flagged):    ", sum(!CN_archive$included_in_analysis, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")
cat("Exclusion breakdown:\n")
print(CN_archive %>% count(exclusion_reason, sort = TRUE))
cat("\nOutput: LCC_LegacyCarbon_archive.csv\n")
```

# ── Downstream analysis subsets ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    sum(CN.all$included_in_analysis, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# sites analyzed for combusted legacy C (restricted to prefire legacy C present)

# ── SOL C combustion source breakdown (field measured / modelled / other) ──

CN.all %>%
 # filter(included_in_analysis) %>%

# How many rows failed pre/post-bomb classification entirely? (Step A)

# rc_age row count right after combining prebomb/postbomb, BEFORE structural fixes

# How many rows removed by the MID->BOTTOM relabeling fix specifically? (Step B)
bind_rows(prebomb, postbomb_1) %>%

# Grouping by soilID alone (the documented unique core ID)

  filter(Section_new %in% c("TOP","MID","BOTTOM")) %>%
  distinct(soilID, Section_new) %>%
  count(soilID) %>%
  count(n)

# Does soilID ever appear under more than one fire/site/plot combo?
# If this returns any rows, that confirms the compound grouping was fragmenting real cores.
radio %>% distinct(fire, site, plot, soilID) %>% count(soilID) %>% filter(n > 1)
